reviews.title: Good drive
reviews.comment: The drive is working great so far. Speeds pretty good at 287 MBs sequential read and write. I have just one drive and it's not really noticeably loud beyond the sound of the computer fans. I've got 22.35 terabytes when drive is formatted. This can hold my whole lifetime worth of local data storage. Came with a 5 year warranty card in the package
reviews.author: A V

reviews.title: Highly recommend this listing
reviews.comment: Excellent condition only 7 hours on this HDD. Crystal disk showed this disc in 100% working order, this is the 2nd one I have purchased off this seller and can’t recommend enough. I use this for a NAS
reviews.author: khpro

reviews.title: Works as expected
reviews.comment: So far so good. No issues. I was surprised it came with 5y warranty even though its a refurbished drive.
reviews.author: TheOnlyCure

reviews.title: Dead On Arrival
reviews.comment: I rolled the dice on this drive and came up with snake eyes. No matter where I plugged it into, the Disk Manager never saw it as a drive to format. Further, it would make a buzz noise every five seconds. Various things I did to see if it would work failed. Bummer 'cause had it worked, a 24TB HD for $600 was a good price. Fortunately, because Amazon was the shipper, I was able to return it without issue.
reviews.author: AstroNerdBoy

reviews.title: Great capacity!
reviews.comment: Have these in my NAS. They work as expected and perform well.  No complaints on my side.  Would recommend.  Only minor complaint is that when spinning up they can be a bit noisy, but I have tons of space in my NAS for my movies and TV shows.  happy.
reviews.author: Todd Peterson
